messages:
natalie: quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A  we heard a lot about why we win/lose. can we capture the top customer asks and owners here?

sam: +1. quick summary from leadership: wins = predictable perf, quick pilot support, clear security posture. losses = procurement price pushback, lack of private deployment options, and concerns about hallucinations on critical docs.

mira: sales signal: midmarket often drops at procurement because they want per-route price caps. enterprise losses are more legal + KYC/contracting time.

rob: echo from field: biggest win story was a fintech pilot where we beat competitor on 99th percentile latency and reduced cost with caching. they signed because we provided an ops runbook.

tania: cs note: lost two deals last quarter where customers flagged hallucination in domain-specific prompts. they wanted reranker + deterministic fallback to smaller model.

devin: eng update: runtime work (KV caching + batching heuristics) shipping in next patch. should reduce token cost for long-context apps. tracking PR: `runtime/kv-batch` will link.

hemant: product ask: customers want (1) private/VPC deployment timeline (2) explicit SLO packages (3) token-level billing exports for procurement. i suggest a short product brief and milestones.

natalie: proposed owners: Mira -> pricing/playbook & midmarket offers, Devin -> perf SLO + telemetry, Tania -> loss postmortems + hallucination cases, Hemant -> Private timeline. Can owners confirm?

mira: I can own pricing playbook. will sync with finance and solutions eng.

devin: will own perf SLO proposal. aim to post benchmarks + draft SLOs by next Wed.

tania: will pull loss postmortems and sanitize examples. will have top 5 cases by EOW.

rob: can we also collect 3 customer case studies where caching made the difference? i can pull notes.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-4876 "All-hands customer asks & owners" assigned: natalie, mira, devin.

doc-bot: doc created: /internal/all-hands/1797000001-customer-asks-summary (restricted).

sam: small ask  when owners update the ticket please add a 1-line customer-facing message we can share in next partner meeting.

mira: will add messaging and a sample price table for midmarket scenarios.

hemant: also flagging a small engineering request: expose per-request token breakdown behind a feature flag in Console. Devin, want to iterate?

devin: yes. will prototype a `telemetry.token_breakdown` flag. if product likes it we can beta with a few customers.

tania: one more: customers asked for longer metrics retention (90d -> 1y) for compliance audits. is that feasible?

devin: storage cost + retention policies discussion needed. i'll put a note for infra team and estimate next week.

natalie: ok plan: owners will add 2-line status to TICKET-4876 by EOD Monday. we'll reconvene at leadership sync next Thurs with draft playbook + SLOs.

sam: thanks all  short and action-oriented. feel free to @me on the ticket if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
